letters.subject: Invoice 0347: VAT registration number
letters.body:
Hello Gareth,

Thank you for invoice 0347, dated 19 October 2026, for £362.88. It charges £60.48 VAT, but it doesn't show a VAT registration number and we have no VAT number on file for you, so we can't treat it as a VAT invoice.

If you are VAT registered, could you send a copy showing your VAT number? If not, please send a corrected invoice without the VAT. A reply by Friday 13 November would help us pay you promptly.

Kind regards,
Accounts Administrator
Demo Company Ltd

letters.subject: Statement query: copy of invoice HC-7769, please
letters.body:
Hello Ruth,

Thank you for your statement. It lists invoice HC-7769, dated 16 October 2026, for £432.00, but we have no record of receiving it.

Could you send a copy of invoice HC-7769, please, by Friday 13 November, so we can process it?

Kind regards,
Accounts Administrator
Demo Company Ltd

letters.subject: Invoice PAL-6620: change of bank details
letters.body:
Hello Imogen,

We have received invoice PAL-6620, dated 13 October 2026, for £484.80, with new bank details. The details on the invoice (sort code 00-99-07) are different from the ones we hold for you.

Before any payment is made, we will phone you on the number we already have on file to confirm the change. We never change bank details because of an email, so please don't send bank details by reply. If you did not ask for this change, please let us know straight away.

Kind regards,
Accounts Administrator
Demo Company Ltd
